text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Satsuki Sho is here. Being the first race of the Classic Triple Crown, the crowd's expectations are high.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, many in the crowd express doubts as to whether Smart Falcon, a dirt runner, will be able to perform on turf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite trying to put on a brave face, Smart Falcon isn't able to hide her nervousness. I send her off with an encouraging chant.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning concerts at Classic Triple Crown races are special, and Smart Falcon heads to the race aiming to take center stage.
